steps.title: Topic first, then the comment
body: An A1 sentence has two parts: the topic (what you are talking about) and the comment (what you say about it). There is no verb — no word for "is".
So to write one, put the topic first — usually the word with الـ — then the comment: a describing word, a place, or something pointed at.
In the next step the tiles are whole words, not letters. Put the topic word on the right, then build left from there.

steps.title: Hear the seven sentences
steps.intro: Listen to each sentence and read along. Notice the order: topic, then comment. You will rebuild these from word tiles next.

steps.title: Find the topic
steps.prompt: Which word is the topic — what the sentence is about?
steps.explanation: الطَّقْسُ ("the weather") is the topic; حَارٌّ ("hot") is the comment about it.

steps.title: You wrote whole sentences
steps.message: You put the topic first and the comment after, with no verb between them, and built seven A1 sentences from word tiles. Practise them in the Review view.
